visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article listing that readers can filter by category
visualCharacteristics.layout: Centered, wrapping row of outlined uppercase pill buttons (active pill filled navy); below, a grid of article cards: 1 column on mobile, 2 from 600px, 3 from 900px. Each card: rounded photo, small teal category label, navy bold title, description, optional read time
visualCharacteristics.sectionMetadata: None required; place the block in its own section below the page intro

contentPattern.structure: Cell 1: article photo. Cell 2: category (first paragraph, plain text), title heading containing the link to the article, description paragraph, optional read-time paragraph last (e.g. "5 min. read"). Optional config rows before the articles: "All" | label of the show-all pill (omit for no show-all pill; clicking the active pill again always shows all articles); "Filter label" | accessible name of the pill group. Pills are built from the distinct categories in card order; ?category=<slug> in the URL preselects a pill
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Articles overview: ALL pill plus 10 category pills (Obesity Care, Weight maintenance, Weight loss, ...) above 92 article teasers with photo, category, title, description and read time

usage: Articles overview page listing all articles with category filtering.
reuseGuidance: Use when a list of article teasers should be filterable by category on the page. Use cards-article-slider for a short, hand-picked related-articles row without filtering.
